findings.what: test_every_ramp_renders_a_preview only checks dtype, shape and 'not one flat colour'. It never checks that cell i shows ramp[i], or that the cells differ from each other.
findings.why: The preview is the point of the card. The module passes `srgb_to_linear(positions)` as luma, and the test would still pass if the luma transform were wrong or every cell drew the same glyph. Only one inked pixel is needed for `max > min`. A wrong luma-to-glyph mapping would also not be caught.
findings.fix: Render each ramp and slice the image into columns of width PREVIEW_CELL[0]. Assert that the column ink pattern equals what `glyph_ramp` draws for that glyph alone (for example a 1-glyph ramp rendered separately). At minimum assert that distinct glyphs of a ramp, one with distinct masks, give distinct column bytes.

findings.what: The 100 ms test warms the cache with the first and last ramp, then times the first one again. It therefore measures only a cache hit.
findings.why: Accept says 'selecting a set updates the preview within 100 ms'. A cold selection of a CJK, braille or card ramp (glyph rasterisation and font fallback) is never timed, so the budget is unproven for the path a user actually hits.
findings.fix: Time every ramp once after a single global warm-up. Alternatively time the cold selection of each category's first ramp and assert the maximum is under 100 ms. If the cold cost is too high, pre-warm the glyph masks off-thread.

findings.what: `select_ramp` across categories triggers `_on_category_changed`, which selects row 0 of the new category. That renders and emits `ramp_chosen` for the wrong ramp, and then the target ramp is rendered and emitted a second time.
findings.why: A host listening to `ramp_chosen` sees a spurious intermediate choice, and every cross-category selection renders the preview twice. The 100 ms budget gets less headroom.
findings.fix: Wrap the programmatic selection in `blockSignals` on both lists, refill the set list by hand, then call `_show` once. Decide explicitly whether programmatic selection should emit `ramp_chosen`.

findings.what: `Path(target).open(...)` wraps a value that is already a Path. `Catalogue.get` and `Catalogue.category` rebuild a dict on every call.
findings.fix: Use `target.open(...)`. Build the id indexes once.

findings.what: The `_pixmap` dangling-buffer fix (defect 4) has no test that can fail on the old code.
findings.why: `QImage(...).copy()` is the fix, but the test only compares pixmap width. Reading from a freed buffer may not show up under offscreen Qt.
findings.fix: Accept that it cannot be tested, or assert the pixmap pixel content (`toImage()`) equals `preview_rgb8` after a `gc.collect()`.
